title: Multi-Stage Crooked Indifferentiability
summary: The current crooked-indifferentiability replacement/composition guarantee is single-stage; a multi-stage version for disjoint adversaries remains open.

formal_statement.body: Can crooked indifferentiability and its replacement/composition guarantee, currently restricted to single-stage settings, be extended to multi-stage settings in which disjoint adversaries are split across several stages?

scope.domain: Cryptographic indifferentiability frameworks and their replacement/composition guarantees.
assumptions: The target multi-stage setting uses disjoint adversaries split across several stages.
parameters: Number of stages — distinguishes the current single-stage setting from the proposed multi-stage setting
Adversary allocation — specifies how disjoint adversaries are split across stages
scope.unresolved_remainder: Develop a multi-stage extension of crooked indifferentiability and its replacement/composition guarantee for disjoint adversaries divided among several stages.

citations.label: Crooked Indifferentiability of the Feistel Construction

progress.summary: The paper states that its replacement/composition theorem is restricted to single-stage settings and leaves extension to multiple stages with disjoint adversaries as future work.
citation_labels: Alexander Russell et al., Crooked Indifferentiability of the Feistel Construction
